component.name: Blossom
component.summary: Org mode notes, tasks and agenda

description.p: Blossom is a desktop app for a folder of org mode files. It reads and edits them in place, so Emacs, git and Syncthing keep working on the same files.

ul.li: Outline, reading view and a section editor that changes only what you edit
Search with Orgzly-style queries, or by meaning
An agenda by week, month, quarter or year, with a timeline of ongoing work
Capture templates, refile and archive with undo
Inline images and diagrams stored as Excalidraw files

description.p: It comes with blsm, a command-line tool for search, agenda and capture.

A reworked interface: a top bar, a Settings panel that writes config.toml, a new agenda with Week, Month, Quarter and Year views and an Ongoing timeline, capture in the full editor, a formatting toolbar, and Emacs keys in the editor.
